section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Gratitude measure used in the current study, which is the validated Dutch version of the Short Gratitude, Resentment, and Appreciation Test (SGRAT-NL). It describes the 16-item scale, its 9-point Likert response format, and reports a high Cronbach's alpha of .86 for the current study, comparable to previous research.
